Title: LSJ- Ivory Bow and Rowan Ring

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
If Tariq, who has a Ghoul Retainer, strikes my vampire who has 2 blood
with the Ivory Bow, while the Ghoul Retainer strikes with the Rowan
Ring.

Assuming I strike for hands for 1 and don't prevent any damage, how
much blood am I going to torpor with?

Would this total change if an Amaranth is being played?

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
XZealot <xze...@cox.net> wrote:
> If Tariq, who has a Ghoul Retainer, strikes my vampire who has 2 blood
> with the Ivory Bow, while the Ghoul Retainer strikes with the Rowan
> Ring.

> Assuming I strike for hands for 1 and don't prevent any damage, how
> much blood am I going to torpor with?

You are going to torpor and taking 1 aggravated damage, during the
same strike resolution phase.
So if you started with 2 blood, you'd be in torpor with 1 blood.

> Would this total change if an Amaranth is being played?

Why would it?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Sep 2, 9:28 am, Jozxyqk <jfeue...@eecs.tufts.edu> wrote:

> XZealot <xzea...@cox.net> wrote:
> > If Tariq, who has a Ghoul Retainer, strikes my vampire who has 2 blood
> > with the Ivory Bow, while the Ghoul Retainer strikes with the Rowan
> > Ring.
> > Assuming I strike for hands for 1 and don't prevent any damage, how
> > much blood am I going to torpor with?
>
> You are going to torpor and taking 1 aggravated damage, during the
> same strike resolution phase.
> So if you started with 2 blood, you'd be in torpor with 1 blood.

Correct. All effects are applied before moving to the "handle any
damage applied" sub-step.
So by the time you're handling the agg, you're already wounded by the
Ring. Meaning you have to burn 1 blood to prevent destruction.

> > Would this total change if an Amaranth is being played?
>
> Why would it?

"No" is correct.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
Blooded Sand <sand...@gmail.com> wrote:
>Emphasis in quoted text mine.

Mis-understanding also yours.

>GR may use the weapon before or after.

No. Ghoul Retainer may use a weapon that has not been used by the
employing minion or another retainer before the Ghoul Retainer uses it,
or after the Ghoul Retainer uses it.

That is, if the employer (or another retainer) has used the weapon, this
Ghoul Retainer can't use it. If this Ghoul Retainer uses it, the
employer (or other retainers) can't use it later in this round.

>If I strike with the bow and THEN GR strikes with RR, should there not
>be 2 blood? I choose the order do I not?

Not.
